name: EQT Ventures s.r.o. (Bratislava)
decision_note: Small Bratislava company with AIF management among many generic trade licences; no fund, portfolio or website found, and no link to the Swedish EQT Ventures.

evidence.quote: vytváranie a spravovanie alternatívnych investičných fondov a zahraničných alternatívnych investičných fondov

analyst_notes: Not the EQT AB venture arm (EQT Ventures, Stockholm): sole shareholder is a Slovak individual (e2) and no public material connects the two. RÚZ 2025 (micro entity): total assets EUR 0.82m, equity EUR 0.10m; notes are a generic template. No managed fund appears in the Bank of Spain list of Slovak funds. Web search budget exhausted during the screen, so news was not checked.
